name: GLM-5.4 launches in Z.ai Coding Plan: first Loop Transformer from Zhipu, with vision and 1M context
title: GLM-5.4 launches in Z.ai Coding Plan: first Loop Transformer from Zhipu, with vision and 1M context
summary: Z.ai released GLM-5.4, which loops existing GLM-5 layers for deeper reasoning and adds vision for coding, video, 3D shaders and CAD tasks. It is available through the Coding Plan and API now; weights are not out yet and Zhipu's Chinese notice reportedly gives the architecture detail (looped transformer, about 700B parameters, technical report later).
